notes.title: End of Service Announcement(March 11, 2019)
notes.content:
Dear. Checkmate Players

We are very sorry to inform you that the Early Access service of  will not be updated from now and end the service on March 11, 2019. 

We are so grateful to have the opportunity to present our project to you. It was very hard to make this decision to end the service of Checkmate. 

- Service Shutdown: March 11, 2019, 12AM (UTC)
- Cash purchase no longer available from Feb 11, 2019.

Thanks to all your support for .

Team Checkmate

notes.title: Patch Note 01 - 2019 Jan
notes.content:
Here,  will have the first patch since we released Early Access. 
Patch will be done within next week, we will announce for more details later.
First, we would like to share the patch details in advance. Please kindly read the patch note below. If you have any ideas or suggestions, we open our eyes and ears to listen you!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/3f87b9a334690abb8c764e29be378714eaa7a3fd.png

New Units Update!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/3d7e2fa4b078a10b7484ca09820cb1c1b6605712.gif
Olena (Left) & Ellen (Right)
Position: Pistol
Attack Range: Long-Range


Shop
• Unit Pack Price Changed
- Unit Pack Basic (2 Units): [strike]2000 Bit[/strike] → 1450 Bit
- Unit Pack Smart (4 Units): [strike]190 Cash[/strike] → 110 Cash
- Unit Pack Standard (6 Units): [strike]480 Cash[/strike] → 460 Cash

• Unit Item Price Changed
- Normal (*10 ea): [strike]2000 Bit[/strike] → 1800 Bit
- Rare(*2 ea): [strike]200 Cash[/strike] → 110 Cash
- Epic(*1 ea): [strike]1000 Cash[/strike] → 900 Cash

• Delete Unit Product Refresh
:Unit product lists were refreshed every 4 hours, it could be refreshed immediately by Cash before. 


Balance Changes
• Hero Skills
- Shanon the Assassin
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/01465580bb53edb3feca70efac8eaafd6790e9f5.jpg

- Brandt the Fighter
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/78f1371f694a5579fa55c9dce5c170cdd5795475.jpg

• Unit Balance Changes
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/dd72fb07bad6e455a513e0ebb9a1d95de323a67e.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/2cb8e299902b4ea2a29e9c4ca01668616957db76.jpg

• Battle Related Change
- Flame on the ground: from [strike]7 rounds[/strike] → 9 rounds (Give HP Damage: turn end → turn start)
- Block Breaking: Max [strike]2 times[/strike] → 1 time per turn
- No duplicated units in the deck(Cannot set same unit both in starter/backup) 

• Forced Disconnection Penalty
: Give penalty to deduct Rating Point if a player disconnects the game by force during the battle

User Friendly Interface (UI Changes)
• Battle Scene UI change
- Shows my Backup Units on screen
- Enemy’s skill icon won’t cover my characters in the field anymore
• Game Option: Available to change Setting (Graphic, Sounds, etc) from battle screen

Language
• New language added: Russian (Very special thanks to Павел Ляшко who makes this possible!)
 
Other Changes
• Effect
- Add coin toss up animation while selecting attack order
- Add Arena Emblem change effect in the lobby when your arena promoted/demoted.
- Flame on the ground time/effect changes (related to balance change)


Coming Soon……
New Hero! Rosé the Commander..the update will be coming in soon.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33986817/a9ca8465adc24cc3c09f2f0b8789339e10a9dffd.png

We assume to update new Hero Rosé in Feb. 
Please be patient to meet for new character! 


Feel free to share us if you have any opinions! 

-Team Checkmate-

notes.title: Closed Beta Test is now OPEN! Come and Play!!
notes.content:
We opens the server 24 hours for CBT but we would like to recommend you to play the game as following times for better battle matching.

↓↓ Click the link below! Fill in the survey and GET CBT BETA KEY!! ↓↓
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1_AaPDRe2GtJeradTXsKFYNmAxpu7o8s-d4EtKLIl3MU

-CBT Schedule(We extended the period!!)-


 EST(Eastern Standard Time) December 12th 20:30PM ~ December 18th 00:00AM 
 PST(Pacific Standard Time) December 12th 17:30PM ~ December 17th 09:00PM 
 UTC(Universal Time Coordinated) December 13th 01:30AM ~ December 18th 05:00AM 
 CET(Central European Time) December 13th 02:30AM ~ December 18th 06:00AM 
 KST(Korea Standard Time) December 13th 10:30AM ~ December 18th 14:00PM 


-Best Matching Time-

 EST(Eastern Standard Time) 19:30PM~21:30PM / 12:00AM~02:00AM / 05:00AM~07:00AM
 PST(Pacific Standard Time) 16:30PM~18:30PM / 21:00PM~13:00PM / 02:00AM~04:00AM
 UTC(Universal Time Coordinated) 12:30AM~02:30AM / 05:00AM~07:00AM / 10:00AM~12:00PM
 CET(Central European Time) 01:30AM~03:30AM / 06:00AM~08:00AM / 11:00AM~13:00PM
 KST(Korea Standard Time) 09:30AM~11:30AM / 14:00PM~16:00PM / 19:00PM~21:00PM


Since > is real-time PvP game, you might have difficulty to have proper matching if you are not playing the game in our best matching time. So, please come and play during the best matching time we mentioned above. :D 

-Note-
* All the data during CBT will be reset.
* For your better game test, we will give additional 30,000 Bit (Game Money) in each account.
* Balance, Price, Chance (Drop rate) can be changed after Closed Beta Test.

When we open > on Early Access, we will give rewards 30,000 Bit (Game Money) to all CBT attendants. Also, special prizes to top 10 CBT rankers as below. 

*CBT Ranker Rewards*
1st: 2,000 Cash
2nd: 1,000 Cash
3rd: 500 Cash
4th~10th: 250 Cash

We wait you all in our CBT battlefield, please join our CBT and give us your feedback!::Z4_Heart:
Thank you!

Team Checkmate
